text:
Predicates:
InCity(x, y) ::: x is in city y.
InState(x, y) ::: x is in state y.
City(x) ::: x is a city.
State(x) ::: x is a state.
InSameState(x, y) ::: x and y are in the same state.
ExceptFor(x, y, z, w) ::: x and y are the only cities in states z and w.
Premises:
City(butte) ∧ City(helena) ∧ City(missoula) ∧ State(montana) ::: Montana includes Butte, Helena, and Missoula.
InCity(whiteSulphurSprings, montana) ∧ InCity(butte, montana) ::: White Sulphur Springs and Butte are cities in Montana.
¬InCity(stPierre, montana) ::: St Pierre is not in Montana.
∀x (InCity(x, butte) → ¬InCity(x, stPierre)) ::: Any city in Butte is not in St Pierre.
ExceptFor(butte, stPierre, montana, _) ::: Butte and St Pierre are the only cities in their respective states, which are different.
Conclusion:
InSameState(butte, stPierre)
